MemeDef.label: communal
MemeDef.description: No owner stands apart from the hearth; what one household has, the settlement shares.

MemeDef.label: nudism
MemeDef.description: Skin bared to hearth-light is nothing to hide.

MemeDef.label: ancestor reverence
MemeDef.description: The dead are honored by how gently the living treat one another.

MemeDef.label: elders lead
MemeDef.description: An elder's word settles what argument cannot.

MemeDef.label: ascendant
MemeDef.description: The forge answers to whoever is strong enough to master it, not to the settlement at large.

MemeDef.label: modesty
MemeDef.description: A covenant-keeper is never seen bare before the forge's judgment.

MemeDef.label: martial valor
MemeDef.description: A taste for the fight, tempered by the forge, is a virtue rather than a vice.

MemeDef.label: forgemasters lead
MemeDef.description: Whoever masters the forge, masters the covenant.
